title: Spectrum TG45SC-E Petrol Lawn Scarifier/Aerator with Electric Key Start
description_html:
Spectrum TG45SC-E 2-in-1 Petrol Lawn Scarifier/Aerator with Electric Key Start

If your lawn is struggling with moss, thatch, or weeds, the Spectrum TG45SC-E is the ideal solution. Designed to rejuvenate tired grass areas, this versatile 2-in-1 machine allows you to both scarify and aerate with ease—helping you achieve a healthier, greener lawn all year round.

Perfect for use after periods of drought and during key lawn care seasons such as spring and autumn, this machine is suitable for maintaining lawns up to 2000m².

A standout feature of the TG45SC-E is its Electric Key Start system, making starting the machine quick and effortless. This is especially beneficial for users who may find traditional recoil starting difficult, offering added convenience and ease of use.

Powerful & Reliable Performance

At the heart of the TG45SC-E is a robust 223cc petrol engine, delivering consistent power to tackle compacted soil and stubborn thatch. The addition of the Electric Key Start, alongside a traditional recoil backup, ensures dependable and hassle-free starting every time. The machine runs on standard unleaded petrol for convenience.

2-in-1 Scarifying & Aerating

With a generous 45cm working width and 18 durable blades, this machine makes light work of lawn renovation. The 6 adjustable working heights (-12mm to +10mm) allow you to precisely tailor the working depth, improving air, water, and nutrient penetration for stronger, healthier grass growth.

Blade Engage System

A practical blade engagement feature adds both convenience and safety. Simply activate the green lever to engage the blades when working, and release it to stop them instantly—ideal when emptying the collector. The engine continues running, eliminating the need for frequent restarts and saving time.

Durable & User-Friendly Design

Built with a robust steel deck, the TG45SC-E is designed for long-term durability. Foldable handles with soft grips enhance comfort during extended use and allow for compact storage. Double ball-bearing wheels ensure smooth and stable manoeuvrability across a variety of lawn conditions.

Efficient Debris Collection

The large 45-litre collector efficiently captures moss, thatch, and debris, helping to keep your lawn tidy and reducing downtime. For heavier debris, the machine can also be used without the collector for easier bulk clearing.

Ideal for Medium to Large Lawns

Designed for areas up to 2000m², this machine is perfect for larger gardens and more demanding lawn care tasks. Its combination of power, versatility, and ease of use makes it a reliable choice for maintaining a well-presented lawn.

Final Thoughts

The Spectrum TG45SC-E combines powerful performance with added convenience thanks to its Electric Key Start system. With its durable build, adjustable settings, and dual functionality, it’s an excellent all-in-one solution for keeping your lawn in peak condition with minimal effort.

Tip: Keep moss and thatch separate from compost to help prevent regrowth.

Key Features

  • Electric Key Start for quick, effortless starting
  • Powerful 223cc petrol engine
  • 2-in-1 scarifying and aerating functionality
  • 6 adjustable working heights (-12mm to +10mm)
  • Durable steel deck construction
  • Foldable, soft-grip handles for comfort and storage
  • 45L debris collector for efficient clean-up
  • Double ball-bearing wheels for smooth manoeuvrability
  • Suitable for lawns up to 2000m²

Overall Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (4.9/5)

A highly versatile and robust scarifier/aerator that makes lawn rejuvenation straightforward—ideal for achieving a healthier, more resilient lawn with minimal effort.

title: Honda HF 2625 HME Premium Lawn Tractor
description_html:
Honda HF 2625 HME Premium Lawn Tractor 

For those managing expansive lawns, the Honda HF 2625 HME Premium Lawn Tractor offers an exceptional blend of power, advanced features, and reliable performance. Designed to efficiently cover areas of up to 2 acres, this premium lawn tractor is built with Honda’s signature engineering and innovative technology to deliver an outstanding mowing experience.

Powerful & Efficient Performance

At the heart of the HF 2625 HME is an OHC V-twin 4-stroke Honda GXV660 engine with a 688cc displacement, capable of producing 13.8 kW at 2800 rpm. This robust petrol engine, paired with a hydrostatic transmission, ensures smooth and continuously variable speed control, making it effortless to navigate varied terrains while maintaining a consistent and powerful cut.

Wide Cutting & Adjustable Heights

Featuring an impressive 122 cm cutting width, this lawn tractor is engineered to cover large areas swiftly and efficiently. With 7 cutting height settings ranging from 29 mm to 90 mm, you can easily adjust the cut to suit your lawn’s specific needs, whether you’re aiming for a manicured finish or a more natural look.

Enhanced Grass Collection & Extended Runtime

The HF 2625 HME is equipped with a substantial 350-litre grass collector that minimizes downtime by reducing the frequency of stops to empty clippings. Coupled with an 8.5-litre fuel tank, this tractor is designed for extended mowing sessions, ensuring you can maintain large lawns with fewer interruptions.

Superior Stability & Advanced Features

Built on a robust platform weighing 263 kg, this tractor offers excellent stability on varied terrains. It features sizable wheels—front wheels (15in x 6in) and rear wheels (18in x 8.50in)—which enhance traction and manoeuvrability. Notably, the HF 2625 HME comes with advanced features such as the Versamow™ selective mulching system, Electromagnetic Blade Brake Control for added safety, a Comfort Seat for extended use, and Automatic Headlights to improve visibility during low-light conditions.

Noise Considerations & Warranty Coverage

Operating at a sound level of 105 dB, the noise output reflects the high-powered performance of this premium machine. Honda supports the HF 2625 HME with a solid warranty of 5 years for domestic use and 1 year for commercial applications, offering long-term peace of mind and underscoring the tractor’s build quality and durability.

Final Verdict

The Honda HF 2625 HME Premium Lawn Tractor is a top-tier choice for homeowners and professionals alike who demand efficiency, durability, and advanced technology for maintaining large lawns. With its powerful 688cc engine, expansive 122 cm cutting deck, versatile cutting height options, and a host of innovative features like Versamow™ mulching and Electromagnetic Blade Brake Control, this tractor is engineered to deliver a pristine finish on lawns up to 2 acres. While its noise level and robust build are inherent to high-performance models, the overall capability and feature set make it a standout option in its class.

Pros:
✅ Powerful 688cc Honda GXV660 engine delivering 13.8 kW at 2800 rpm
✅ Smooth hydrostatic transmission for effortless speed control
✅ Wide 122 cm cutting deck with 7 adjustable cutting heights (29–90 mm)
✅ Large 350-litre grass collector minimizes interruptions
✅ Extended runtime with an 8.5-litre fuel tank
✅ Enhanced stability with robust wheel design and a 263 kg build
✅ Advanced features: Versamow™ selective mulching, Electromagnetic Blade Brake Control, Comfort Seat, Automatic Headlights
✅ Comprehensive warranty: 5 years domestic, 1 year commercial

Overall Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (4.9/5)

A premium lawn tractor that combines powerful performance, advanced technology, and robust design—ideal for maintaining expansive lawns with minimal effort.

title: Spectrum TG480RTTR Rear Tine Rotary Cultivator
description_html:
Spectrum TG480RTTR Rear Tine Rotary Cultivator

Rear-tine tillers don’t come much more powerful or productive than the Spectrum TG480RTTR – a well-built, heavy-duty machine designed to take on demanding digging jobs across gardens and allotments with ease.

At its core is a robust 211cc air-cooled 4-stroke OHV engine, engineered for durability and consistent performance. The overhead valve design not only enhances efficiency but also reduces fuel consumption, noise, and emissions—delivering reliable power without compromise.

A belt-driven transmission ensures smooth power delivery and optimal torque transfer to the heavy-duty tines, allowing the machine to break through compacted soil with ease. Combined with a large-capacity fuel tank, the TG480RTTR is built for extended working sessions with fewer interruptions.

For improved control, the tiller features a two-speed gearbox (1 forward + 1 reverse), making it easier to manoeuvre, reposition, and work in tighter areas. Whether you’re turning over soil or navigating confined spaces, you’ll benefit from greater flexibility and ease of use.

With a generous 48cm working width, this cultivator covers more ground in less time—ideal for larger plots. A sturdy debris guard is also included, helping to protect the operator from flying soil and stones for safer operation.

Delivery & Assembly:

The Spectrum TG480RTTR is supplied boxed for home assembly. For a more convenient option, choose our Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) service—we’ll fully assemble, test, and prepare your machine before delivery. Where possible, we’ll deliver by van and provide a brief demonstration, so you can get started straight away with confidence.

title: Honda HRX 537 HY Self-Propelled Petrol Lawn Mower
description_html:
Honda HRX 537 HY Self-Propelled Petrol Lawnmower 

If you’re looking for a high-performance petrol lawnmower with advanced engineering and versatile features, the Honda HRX 537 HY is an outstanding choice. Designed for both domestic and commercial use, this mower combines Honda’s renowned engine reliability with a sophisticated hydrostatic transmission, delivering a superior mowing experience for medium to large lawns.

Powerful & Efficient Performance

At the heart of the HRX 537 HY is an OHC 4-stroke Honda GCV201 engine boasting a 202cc displacement and a power output of 4.2 kW at 3600 rpm. This robust engine, coupled with a reliable recoil start system, ensures you have the power you need to tackle even the toughest grass. The hydrostatic transmission offers smooth, variable speed control, making it easier to adjust your pace and achieve consistent, efficient mowing.

Precision Cutting & Adjustable Heights

With a generous 53 cm cutting width, this mower is engineered to cover large areas quickly. Its versatile cutting system provides 7 adjustable cutting heights ranging from 19mm to 101mm, allowing you to customise the lawn’s appearance to your preference. Whether you desire a finely trimmed look or a more natural finish, the HRX 537 HY adapts seamlessly to your lawn care needs.

Durable Build & Advanced Design

Featuring a polymer cutter deck, the HRX 537 HY benefits from a lightweight yet durable design that resists rust and wear, ensuring longevity under frequent use. The wheeled design combined with self-propulsion delivers a smooth and effortless mowing experience. Although the mower weighs 44kg, its robust construction and balanced design provide stability and performance even on challenging terrains.

Superior Grass Collection & Noise Considerations

Equipped with a spacious 88-litre grass collector, this model minimizes the need for frequent emptying, allowing you to maintain a tidy lawn with less interruption. With a noise level of 98 dB, the HRX 537 HY operates within the standard range for high-performance petrol mowers, balancing power with acceptable sound output.

Spacious Dimensions & Ease of Use

The mower’s dimensions (1665 x 588 x 1122 mm) contribute to a stable platform that is easy to maneuver, whether you’re managing a large backyard or a commercial space. Its self-propelled feature further enhances usability, reducing manual effort and ensuring a smoother, more comfortable mowing experience.

Reliable Warranty Coverage

Honda stands behind the HRX 537 HY with a robust warranty offering 7 years for domestic use and 1 year for commercial applications. This warranty underlines Honda’s confidence in the product’s durability and long-term performance, providing peace of mind for every user.

Final Verdict

The Honda HRX 537 HY Self-Propelled Petrol Lawnmower excels as a powerful, efficient, and versatile tool for maintaining expansive lawns. Its robust Honda engine, innovative hydrostatic transmission, and expansive cutting deck make it ideal for both home and professional use. While its 44kg weight and 98 dB noise level are typical of high-powered petrol mowers, the overall performance, durability, and impressive grass collector capacity make it a top contender in its class.

Pros:
✅ Robust 202cc Honda engine with excellent power
✅ Smooth hydrostatic transmission for variable speed control
✅ Wide 53 cm cutting deck with 7 adjustable cutting heights
✅ Large 88-litre grass collector for extended mowing sessions
✅ Durable, lightweight polymer cutter deck
✅ Reliable warranty: 7 years domestic, 1 year commercial

Cons:
❌ Heavier at 44kg, which might affect manoeuvrability for some users
❌ Noise level at 98 dB, standard for petrol mowers but noteworthy

Overall Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (4.8/5)

title: Honda Izy HRG 416 PK Petrol Lawn Mower

This advanced four-stroke engine delivers enhanced combustion through improved turbulence in the chamber, ensuring reliable performance even with lower-quality fuels. The new Auto Choke system provides superior temperature sensing and choke optimisation, making starting effortless, even in challenging conditions.

Enhanced Maintenance and Usability

The new Izy range is designed with user convenience in mind:

  • Improved Access: Easily serviceable parts such as the oil drain and spark plug, plus tool-free access to the air filter.

Durability and Superior Design

The steel cutter deck ensures a long service life with its robust and high-quality construction. Its rounded design optimises airflow for outstanding grass collection while simplifying cleaning by preventing grass buildup. The folding handles allow for compact storage, even in tight spaces.

Efficiency and Performance

The 42-litre grass bag reduces the need for frequent emptying, featuring an intuitive slot-in/slot-out design for effortless handling. A built-in rear shield protects your legs when removing the bag. With six adjustable cutting heights ranging from 20 to 74 mm, the Izy HRG 416 PK gives you full control to achieve your ideal lawn finish.

Why Choose the Honda Izy HRG 416 PK?

This mower is designed for intuitive operation—no complicated learning curve is required. Its practical features make maintenance and storage a breeze, while the durable build ensures long-lasting performance.

Comprehensive Warranty

The Honda Izy HRG 416 PK comes with a 5-year domestic warranty (subject to annual servicing), one of the most comprehensive warranties in the industry. Honda’s reputation for quality and reliability means you can trust your mower to perform season after season.

The Honda Izy HRG 416 PK is the perfect combination of simplicity, durability, and cutting-edge technology, making it an excellent choice for keeping your lawn looking pristine.

description_html:
PLEASE NOTE; THIS IS A BOXED ITEM – THE INSTALLATION OF THIS MACHINE IS THE RESPONSIBILITY OF  THE CUSTOMER

Miimo HRM 1000B – The Perfect Cut, Every Time

The Honda Miimo HRM 1000B is the ideal robotic mower for those seeking a hassle-free lawn care solution. Designed for smaller gardens up to 1,000m², this compact yet powerful mower delivers the same cutting precision and terrain-handling ability as larger models, effortlessly managing slopes of up to 25 degrees.

With its simple, intuitive display, controlling Miimo is as easy as pressing start, stop, or sending it home. Plus, Bluetooth connectivity ensures seamless integration with the Mii-Monitor app, allowing complete control directly from your smartphone.

Effortless Control & Smart Features

Bluetooth Connectivity

Take full command of Miimo via the Mii-Monitor App, providing remote control and easy operation from your smartphone.

Intuitive Display

A clear, user-friendly interface lets you start, stop, or send Miimo back to its charging station with just a tap.

Advanced Responsive Sensors

  • 360° lift sensing ensures safety by stopping the blades if Miimo is picked up.
  • Sealed system provides durable, all-weather performance, keeping Miimo running day after day.
  • Enhanced bump detection reduces noise and improves navigation around obstacles.

Fast Charging for Continuous Mowing

The Miimo HRM1000B recharges in just 40 minutes, ensuring minimal downtime and continuous operation to keep your lawn looking flawless.

What’s included in the Honda HRM1000B Miimo price

This listing comprises the Miimo robotic lawnmower, a base station and cable, and enough boundary and pegs to complete an installation on an average lawn up to 1,000 m².

Reliable Lawn Care with Perimeter Wire Precision

Miimo requires a perimeter wire—also known as a boundary wire—to operate effectively. This wire emits a continuous signal that clearly defines the mowing area, guiding the robotic mower with precision. Unlike some wireless robotic mowers that can occasionally lose connection due to signal interference or satellite issues, Miimo’s wired system offers consistent and reliable performance without relying on GPS. This makes it a more dependable choice for maintaining a perfectly cut lawn.

Unrivalled Honda Warranty

At Honda, we build products that last longer and perform better. That’s why the Miimo HRM 1000B comes with a comprehensive warranty covering both parts and labour for domestic and professional use. Unlike other warranties, Honda ensures full coverage from day one until the last day of the period, giving you complete peace of mind.

Warranty subject to domestic use and adherence to the service schedule.

title: Honda HRH 536 HX Self-Propelled Petrol Lawn Mower
description_html:
Introducing the Honda HRH 536 HX: The Ultimate Mower for Professionals and Discerning Homeowners

The Honda HRH 536 HX is designed to meet the demands of professional landscapers while offering premium features for homeowners who desire the very best. Powered by the trusted Honda GXV160 OHV 4-stroke engine, this mower combines unmatched reliability and power for effortless, high-performance mowing.

Key Features That Set the HRH 536 HX Apart

  • Honda GXV160 Engine: A powerful, ultra-reliable 4-stroke engine that is perfect for both commercial and home use.
  • Hydrostatic Transmission: Ensures the cutter blades maintain a constant speed relative to the mower’s travel, providing variable speed control for a flawless cut, no matter your pace.
  • Durable Aluminium Deck: Built with high-quality cast aluminium for exceptional strength, a superior strength-to-weight ratio, and resistance to corrosion.
  • Heavy-Duty Build: Features include heavy-gauge handlebar tubing with extra support brackets, a front deck guard, handlebar cable protectors, a shaft drive, and a heavy-duty gearbox for long-lasting durability.
  • Roto-Stop® Blade Safety System: Stop the blades without stopping the engine, allowing you to safely empty the grass bag or navigate obstacles without restarting the mower.
  • Large Grass Bag: A generous 83-litre capacity reduces the need for frequent emptying, saving time and effort.

Effortless Operation for a Perfect Cut

The HRH 536 HX’s hydrostatic transmission allows for step-less speed adjustments using a lever on the handle. This ensures smooth and consistent mowing, whether you’re moving quickly or taking your time for precision.

Built for Professionals, Perfect for Homeowners

With premium-grade features designed to withstand rigorous use, the HRH 536 HX offers a robust and professional mowing experience. From its durable aluminium deck to its reinforced handlebar tubing, every detail is engineered for long-lasting performance and reliability.

Roto-Stop® Technology for Safety and Convenience

Honda’s unique Roto-Stop® Blade Brake Clutch lets you stop the blade without shutting down the engine. This not only saves time but also improves safety when emptying the grass bag or moving across paths and gravel.

Product Overview

  • Cutter Deck Size: 21″ / 53cm
  • Garden Size: Suitable for lawns up to 1,800m² (equivalent to more than two tennis courts)
  • Deck Type: Cast Aluminium – Combines lightweight construction with outstanding strength and corrosion resistance
  • Transmission: Variable Hydrostatic Drive for smooth and seamless speed control
  • Roto-Stop®: Yes – Allows you to stop the blades while keeping the engine running
  • Mulching Capability: Optional – A mulching kit is available for purchase from Honda Dealers

Comprehensive Warranty for Peace of Mind

The Honda HRH 536 HX is backed by an impressive 7-year warranty for domestic use (subject to annual servicing) and a 1-year warranty for commercial environments. Built to last, this mower offers exceptional durability and performance you can rely on for years to come.

title: Stiga A8 Automatic Robotic Lawn Mower
description_html:
STIGA A8 Automatic Robot Lawn Mower

Transform Your Lawn Care Experience with Revolutionary Wire-Free Technology

The STIGA A8 Automatic Robot Lawn Mower represents the pinnacle of autonomous lawn care technology, designed to deliver professional-quality results while giving you complete freedom from traditional mowing routines. Engineered in Italy with precision and reliability at its core, this advanced robotic mower is perfect for larger gardens up to 800m² across 4 separate cutting zones.

Key Features & Benefits

Wire-Free Freedom Experience the ultimate convenience with completely wireless operation. Unlike traditional robotic mowers that require tedious boundary wire installation, the A8 uses revolutionary GPS-RTK technology combined with STIGA’s patented AGS (Active Guidance System) for precise navigation without physical barriers.

Superior Cutting Performance

  • Coverage: Maintains lawns up to 800m² across 4 cutting zones
  • Cutting width: 18cm with 4 pivoting blades
  • Cutting height: Electronically adjustable from 20-60mm
  • Blade speed: 2,850 RPM for clean, precise cuts
  • Maximum cutting speed: 22m/min for efficient coverage

Advanced Navigation Technology The patented RTK AGS technology ensures millimetre-precise navigation, enabling the A8 to systematically cover your entire lawn with optimal efficiency. This intelligent system adapts to domestic garden challenges like walls, fences, and garden structures that typically interfere with standard GPS signals.

The Honda HRX 476 VY combines cutting-edge technology with exceptional performance, making it one of the most efficient and reliable lawnmowers in its class. With its Euro 5-compliant OHC 4-stroke Honda GCVx170 167cc engine, it delivers superior power and torque while being lightweight, fuel-efficient, and easy to start—even after months of winter storage. Thanks to a reduction in parts and a redesigned engine, this model is also up to 2 kg lighter than its predecessor, ensuring enhanced manoeuvrability and ease of use.

Versamow™ 4-in-1 Functionality

Enjoy ultimate flexibility with Honda’s Versamow™ 4-in-1 mowing system, which lets you:

  1. Collect clippings for a pristine lawn.
  2. Mulch clippings for natural fertilisation.
  3. Rear discharge clippings for fast mowing in unmaintained areas.
  4. Mulch and collect simultaneously to optimise grass management.

With Versamow™, there’s no need for a separate mulch plug—simply switch mowing modes via the convenient single lever. This clever design maximises space in the large 69-litre grass bag, reducing emptying trips and saving you time.

Variable Select Drive for Maximum Control

The HRX 476 VY introduces Honda’s advanced Variable Select Drive, offering unmatched smoothness and precision. Adjust the mower’s speed seamlessly using the dial on the control bar, allowing you to maintain a consistent pace that suits your lawn and personal preferences.

Durable Polystrong® Cutter Deck

Built with a robust Polystrong® deck, this mower is lightweight, rust-resistant, and exceptionally durable. The smooth, aerodynamic design enhances grass collection and reduces noise levels, ensuring a quieter and more efficient mowing experience.

Cutting Customisation with 7 Height Settings

With 7 adjustable cutting heights ranging from 25 to 79 mm, you can tailor your lawn’s appearance to perfection. Whether you’re after a close-cropped finish or a longer, healthier look, this mower has you covered.

Convenient Storage with Foldable Handles

Storage is no hassle thanks to the fully folding handles, allowing the HRX 476 VY to fit easily in your shed or garage.

Roto-Stop® Blade-Brake System for Safety and Convenience

Honda’s Roto-Stop® technology ensures maximum safety and ease of use. This unique system allows you to stop the blades without shutting off the engine, so you can safely empty the grass bag, cross driveways, or move obstacles without needing to restart the mower.

Effortless Online Buying with Start ‘N’ Go

Take the stress out of buying your new mower online with Honda’s Start ‘N’ Go service. Whether you’re elderly, disabled, or simply not mechanically inclined, this service ensures your machine is assembled and ready to go upon delivery. Click on the red Start ‘N’ Go tab for more details.

Warranty for Peace of Mind

This mower is backed by Honda’s industry-leading 7-year warranty for domestic use (subject to annual servicing). For commercial use, a 1-year warranty applies. With one of the most comprehensive warranties available, you can trust in Honda’s quality and reliability.

title: HONDA WX10 - FRESH WATER PUMP
description_html:
Why choose this water pump?

The Honda WX10 fresh water pump is powered by a clean running 4-stroke engine which makes it ideal for drainage, irrigation and all-purpose cleaning. It is widely used for clearing flood water, and with a suction head lift of 7 meters it is often used for draining flooded cellars or boats.

 The ‘total head’, or the maximum height the pump can force water from suction head to discharge head, is an impressive 40m (which is around the length of four parked buses parked end to end).

The economical GX25 mini 4-stroke engine emits fewer emissions and is incredibly easy to start. Not only that but being a Honda engine, it’s ultra reliable and has a long working life.

It can move 140 litres of fresh water per minute through its 1-inch pipe. A unique 360 degree lubrication system also enables the pump to operate at virtually any incline without spilling oil or risk of engine damage, as well as ensuring trouble-free operation after transporting and storage.

The WX10 water pump is incredibly lightweight at only 6.1 kg and has an easy carry handle making it ideal for movement wherever it is needed. The anti-vibration platform also protects the machine and increases service life.

It generates an impressive 3.5 bars of pressure for washing down equipment, plus up to 36 metres of total head lift.

Warranty

Honda customers deserve complete peace of mind when they purchase products. That’s why the Honda WX10 fresh water pump comes with a 2 year domestic warranty (subject to annual service) and a 1 year commercial warranty.

title: Echo CS-4510ES Petrol Chainsaw (38cm Guide Bar)
description_html:
Echo CS-4510ES Petrol Chainsaw

The top-quality, Japanese-engineered Echo CS-4510ES is a high-powered, mid-range saw that’s ideal for heavy-duty lopping and felling applications in the domestic, professional and agricultural arenas.

Its relatively compact – and therefore easy to manage – 38cm cutting gear is driven by a muscular but refined, 45cc (3.1hp), two-stroke, ES-Start engine, which employs Echo’s innovative Power Boost Tornado™ technology. This improves combustion efficiency and power delivery, while simultaneously working to minimise exhaust emissions and fuel costs.

The engine also features flywheel-type air pre-cleaning for the best possible performance in dry, dusty conditions.

‘Kick back’, which occurs when one of the chain teeth strikes a stubborn knot in the wood, can be dangerous. Echo have got around this problem by fitting the CS-4510ES with a super-fast-acting chain brake, which bites and stops the chain as soon as any inertia is identified.

The Echo CS-4510ES Petrol Chainsaw features an adjustable automatic chain-oil pump, so you can select the most effective flow rate for the hardness of the timber you’re faced with. The oil flow stops when the engine idles, thus avoiding mess and waste.

This well-balanced, easy handling machine has been equipped with a series of six vibration absorbing mounts and weighs-in at only 5kg; a combination that ensures time-consuming tasks can be finished in comfort.

Convenience-features on the Echo CS-4510ES include dropout prevention, which means nuts won’t be lost during maintenance; and tool-less oil/fuel filler caps, which are large enough to remove with a gloved hand.
